title: FollowOrganizerByPhoneCallablePayload
description: Callable payload accepted by followOrganizerByPhone: follow an organiser with just a verified phone (the website's phone-code sign-in), optionally with the explicit WhatsApp tick that grants the followerUpdates purpose for that phone. No profile is required.

whatsappUpdates.description: True only when the follower ticked the WhatsApp box themselves. False follows without any WhatsApp permission.

termsVersion.description: The reviewed WhatsApp consent copy the follower saw. Required when whatsappUpdates is true.
